verses.text: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.
lines: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge.
Never let me be disappointed.

verses.text: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.
lines: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me.
Turn your ear to me, and save me.

verses.text: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
lines: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go.
Give the command to save me,
for you are my rock and my fortress.

verses.text: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
lines: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked,
from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

verses.text: For you are my hope, Lord Yahweh, my confidence from my youth.
lines: For you are my hope, Lord Yahweh,
my confidence from my youth.

verses.text: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.
lines: I have relied on you from the womb.
You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb.
I will always praise you.

verses.text: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.
lines: I am a marvel to many,
but you are my strong refuge.

verses.text: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.
lines: My mouth shall be filled with your praise,
with your honor all day long.

verses.text: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.
lines: Don’t reject me in my old age.
Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.

verses.text: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,
lines: For my enemies talk about me.
Those who watch for my soul conspire together,

verses.text: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”
lines: saying, “God has forsaken him.
Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”

verses.text: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.
lines: God, don’t be far from me.
My God, hurry to help me.

verses.text: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.
lines: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed.
Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.

verses.text: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.
lines: But I will always hope,
and will add to all of your praise.

verses.text: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
lines: My mouth will tell about your righteousness,
and of your salvation all day,
though I don’t know its full measure.

verses.text: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.
lines: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord Yahweh.
I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.

verses.text: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
lines: God, you have taught me from my youth.
Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.

verses.text: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.
lines: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me,
until I have declared your strength to the next generation,
your might to everyone who is to come.

verses.text: Your righteousness also, God, reaches to the heavens; you have done great things. God, who is like you?
lines: Your righteousness also, God, reaches to the heavens;
you have done great things.
God, who is like you?

verses.text: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.
lines: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles,
you will let me live.
You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

verses.text: Increase my honor and comfort me again.
lines: Increase my honor
and comfort me again.

verses.text: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.
lines: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God.
I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.

verses.text: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!
lines: My lips shall shout for joy!
My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!

verses.text: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.
lines: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long,
for they are disappointed, and they are confounded,
who want to harm me.
